---
title: "Runtime and Ratings"
---
We analyze whether longer runtime correlates with higher audience ratings in fig-runtime-rating.
```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-runtime-rating
#| fig-cap: "IMDb Rating vs. Film Runtime (Minutes)"

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))
plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"], alpha=0.7, color="coral", edgecolors="black")
plt.xlabel("Runtime (Minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating (0 - 10)")
plt.title("Runtime vs IMDb Rating")

plt.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)
plt.show()
#| echo: true
films["decade"] = films["year"]//10*10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
